AWS_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Installation strategy for aws: 'libscript_native' installs into isolated versioned directories and 'system' delegates to the host OS package manager.

AWS_AMI_NAME.description: Target Amazon Machine Image (AMI) name registered or looked up during AWS EC2 provisioning and image import.

AWS_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading aws binary or archive artifacts.

AWS_RELEASES_URL.description: Override URL for querying aws available remote releases.

AWS_S3_BUCKET.description: Amazon S3 bucket name used for VM Import/Export staging, state artifacts, or backup blobs.

AWS_VERSION.description: Specific version of aws to install (e.g., latest, lts, or exact version).
